premises.text: Technology can replace most hospital administrative functions while doctors deliver care
premises.evidence_span: you can replace most of these things with technology

premises.text: Carbon onboarding uses insurance-card scan and short setup instead of long forms
Patients get an actionable phone-based medical chart: images, labs, referrals, appointments, messaging, and home actions
premises.evidence_span: this is more than just a record. It's not just about looking. You can also take action

premises.text: Automated, history-aware intake questions speed new-issue triage before physician review
premises.evidence_span: we've automated a lot of the questions that your doctor would be asking you to save time. And these questions dynamically adjust based on your medical history

premises.text: Hybrid virtual/in-person care shares context across clinic and follow-up channels
premises.evidence_span: a seamless hybrid of virtual and in-person care

premises.text: Prescription fulfillment and automatic pill reminders close the loop on treatment plans
premises.evidence_span: we can schedule the pill reminders automatically, and all you have to do is flip them on

premises.text: End-to-end control of physician and patient applications enables experiences traditional providers cannot offer, expandable to independent practices
premises.evidence_span: we are able to design an experience that would be impossible for the traditional health care providers

value.text: Best possible collaborative care through a ubiquitous doctor-connection platform
value.evidence_span: give the best possible care to their patients

secondary_value.text: World's largest hospital as a technology network rather than buildings
secondary_value.evidence_span: the world's largest hospital won't be about buildings

causal_links.evidence_span: At its core, there are doctors who give the actual care
your clinic doctor has all the context of your virtual interactions
experience that would be impossible for the traditional health care providers
